Chapter 975  Chapter 29: Domineering (Please Subscribe)_2

If Lin Yuan's physical body in the Main Universe were to be replicated there, basically most paths would be firmly established, and the greatest advantage of interdimensional arrival through shuttling would be lost.

As of now, the use of World-Breaking Origin Force for Lin Yuan mainly enhances his life-saving abilities substantially during the initial phase of consciousness arrival.

At least in the beginning stage of arrival, facing certain unavoidable calamities, he could use the World-Breaking Origin Force to evade, striving for sufficient growth time.

With Lin Yuan's Against-Heaven's Understanding, as long as there is enough time, he can easily grow to his limit of potential.

...

"Now, the Myriad Realms Gate, I can directly manipulate it within the Main Universe," Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Whether it's the Main Universe or the Chaos Void, as long as Lin Yuan consumes a certain amount of World-Breaking Origin Force, he can slightly stimulate the Myriad Realms Gate and go to any location he desires.

Theoretically, no existence can block the Myriad Realms Gate.

"This ability is better not used if not necessary," thought Lin Yuan.

The Myriad Realms Gate, an existence that transcends countless timelines, itself steps out of the time streams, and thus those Thirteen-Layer time lifeforms cannot glimpse even a trace of the Myriad Realms Gate.

But if the Myriad Realms Gate is actively used in this Chaos Void, even for just an instant, it will leave behind faint traces.

These traces exist in the past, and if the Thirteen-Layer time lifeforms peer into the past timelines, they might detect it.

Then could trace back to the present and future; even if they still cannot pinpoint the Myriad Realms Gate, they can lock on to Lin Yuan.

After all, the Myriad Realms Gate does not reside within the timeline, but Lin Yuan still does, following the clues, even if they cannot lock onto Lin Yuan precisely, they can still determine an approximate range.

When that time comes, there will be real trouble.

The dimensional shuttling and arrival that Lin Yuan undertakes with the help of the Myriad Realms Gate are completed above the timeline, without affecting this Chaos Void, while actively stimulating the Myriad Realms Gate equates to bringing its essence into this Chaos Void.

The two are entirely different in meaning.

...

After Lin Yuan stepped into the Twelve-Star level, the Myriad Realms Gate gained many new effects, but mainly the aforementioned three.

"This is immensely helpful to me," Lin Yuan was very satisfied in his heart, the Myriad Realms Gate now, from any aspect, is significantly more powerful.

Especially the more specific application of World-Breaking Origin Force, afforded Lin Yuan yet another option at his disposal.

"World-Breaking Origin Force, the World-Breaking Origin Force I have accumulated is still too little," Lin Yuan sighed.

Currently, he has less than three thousand strands of World-Breaking Origin Force; the main issue is that Lin Yuan has existed for too short a time. If he had lived as long as those Twelve-Star ultimates in the Main Universe, with hundreds of billions of years or more, he would definitely have enough World-Breaking Origin Force.

And according to the current capabilities of the Myriad Realms Gate, as long as he has enough World-Breaking Origin Force, he can completely replicate myriad resources for his cultivation.

Of course, replicating resources with World-Breaking Origin Force? Extremely extravagant, unless it's a key resource, otherwise, Lin Yuan wouldn't do so.

...

Human civilization, the third stronghold.

In a magnificent palace, nine thrones were each occupied by a figure.

These were the nine Supremes of human civilization.

And at this moment, in the center of the nine thrones, a new throne was forming.

The tenth great throne.

Just then.

Lin Yuan's figure appeared and he slowly took his seat upon the tenth great throne.

"Galaxy Master, you have arrived."

Xuanyuan Supreme's face showed a smile while the other eight Supremes turned to look at Lin Yuan in unison.

Although Lin Yuan had only recently become a Supreme, there was no contention that he was the first and foremost Supreme of human civilization, with the peak power of Path Splitting Realm, invincible within this universe.

"Hmm..."

Sitting on his throne, Lin Yuan felt a wave of emotion in his heart.

He had been to the third stronghold of human civilization before.

However, at that time, he could only stand below and look up at the nine Supremes of human civilization, who regarded Lin Yuan as just a youngster in their eyes.

"Since the Lord of the Galaxy has arrived, let's discuss serious matters," Xuanyuan Supreme spoke with a solemn expression.

"Serious matters?" Lin Yuan had a sudden realization in his heart.

The "serious matters" referred to by Xuanyuan Supreme must be issues significant enough to affect human civilization; ordinary matters hardly require the Supremes' counsel, as the three goddesses could resolve them alone.

"After the Galaxy Master stepped into the Twelve-Star level, those peak clans have started to retract their territorial influence..."

Xuanyuan Supreme said.

The other Supremes nodded slightly upon hearing this.

The movements of the eleven paramount clans were naturally noticed by them, for human civilization has birthed an unbeatable Galaxy Master, it's only normal for these peak clan forces to act this way.

"As they contracted their respective spheres of influence, those of the Twelve-Star level all reached out to me, expressing a desire to coexist peacefully with human civilization and willing to pay a certain price for it," Lin Yuan said.

The Xuanyuan Supreme continued speaking.

"Peaceful coexistence?" The Supremes chuckled.

Realizing they could not contend with the Galaxy Master, choosing to turn their weapons into gifts of jade and silk to make peace with human civilization was indeed a wise move.

"There are also many powerful clans, ordinary clans, as well as some Ancient Gods, who want to submit and surrender to our human civilization," the Xuanyuan Supreme said.

Lin Yuan's presence was too intimidating, causing even the peak clans guarded by Twelve-Star beings to retreat. The powerful clans, ordinary clans, and the solitary Ancient Gods were naturally scared as well.

"Galaxy Master, the decision is yours," the Xuanyuan Supreme looked at Lin Yuan and said.

Those peak clan forces and Twelve-Star ultimates were acting this way entirely because of Lin Yuan, so how to deal with them ultimately depended on Lin Yuan's thoughts.

"For those powerful clans, ordinary clans, and Ancient Gods who come seeking allegiance, as long as they do not harbor great hatred towards our human civilization, we should accept them all," Lin Yuan pondered for a moment before speaking.

In the Cosmic Starry Skies, though it was known as the Myriad Clans, in reality, it was a battlefield dominated by twelve ultimate peak clans, with many powerful and ordinary clans left adrift without any say.

And this was even more true for the solitary Ancient Gods.

"As for those peak clan forces, aside from the Robber Clan, those who wish to negotiate peace with us, no problem, hand over ninety percent of your Twelve-Star weapons and Twelve-Star level rare treasures, and from now on live within the territory designated by our human civilization," Lin Yuan said casually.

The reason he excluded the Robber Clan was that the human civilization hadn't fought much with them and held no significant grudges, coupled with the fact that two ultimate beings from the Robber Clan had leaked information.

Even if this act of leaking information meant little, even if they hadn't done so, those Twelve-Star ultimates could not do anything against Lin Yuan.

But at least the other side had shown their goodwill proactively.

The origins of the Robber Clan were greater than imagined, and that wood cabin at the Chaos Realm level was not necessarily something Lin Yuan could deal with.

"Hand over ninety percent of Twelve-Star weapons and Twelve-Star rare treasures?" The Xuanyuan Supreme and the other eight Supremes glanced at each other.

Domineering.

Too domineering.

The ninety percent of Twelve-Star weapons and treasures Lin Yuan mentioned included those held by the Twelve-Star ultimates.

This was simply like slicing off the flesh of those Twelve-Stars.

"They probably will find it difficult to agree..." the Xuanyuan Supreme hesitated as he spoke.

"No matter."

"They will agree," Lin Yuan said with a slight smile.

"Alright, I'll inform them right now," the Xuanyuan Supreme nodded and immediately contacted the Twelve-Star ultimates of each great peak clan force.

"Let's leave out the Robber Clan," Lin Yuan added.

"Understood," the Xuanyuan Supreme nodded.

"We should indeed be cautious about the Robber Clan," the other Supremes agreed.

"The Robber Clan probably hails from the Chaos Void," Lin Yuan said.

"Chaos Void?" the Supremes present were greatly surprised; they had always thought that the Robber Clan originated from the previous Cosmic Era, but could it be that there was much more to their story?

"Correct," Lin Yuan nodded. After stepping into the Twelve-Star level, he could see more secrets, including those about the Robber Clan.

"One of my incarnations has already reached the Robber Clan," Lin Yuan said with a thin smile.

...

Deep within Robber Clan territory.

A mysterious and unfathomable place.

Here, there was only an unremarkable wood cabin, floating in the profound starry skies, as if it were eternally enduring.

At this moment.

An invisible force converged, forming a figure.

It was Lin Yuan.

"I've seen the Galaxy Master,"

The moment Lin Yuan appeared, the door of the wood cabin opened on its own, and two figures walked out from within, bowing slightly to Lin Yuan.
